command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; Write-Output ('HOST=' + $env:COMPUTERNAME); Write-Output '===PROCESSES==='; Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match 'desktop|commander|node|npm' } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessName -Unique | Sort-Object; Write-Output '===NPM_GLOBAL==='; npm list -g --depth=0 2>$null | Select-String -Pattern 'desktop-commander|wonderwhy|commander'; Write-Output '===NPX_PACKAGE==='; npx --yes @wonderwhy-er/desktop-commander@latest --version 2>$null | Select-Object -First 3; Write-Output '===CLAUDE_CONFIG_EXISTS==='; $cfg=Join-Path $env:APPDATA 'Claude\claude_desktop_config.json'; Write-Output (Test-Path $cfg); Write-Output '===REMOTE_DC_DIRS==='; $roots=@($env:APPDATA,$env:LOCALAPPDATA,$env:USERPROFILE); foreach($r in $roots){ if($r){ Get-ChildItem -Path $r -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'desktop.*commander|commander.*desktop|wonderwhy' } | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName } } }; Write-Output '===NETWORK==='; $nodePids=(Get-Process node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Id); if($nodePids){ Get-NetTCPConnection -State Established -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $nodePids -contains $_.OwningProcess } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { 'NODE_ESTABLISHED=' + $_.RemoteAddress + ':' + $_.RemotePort } }; exit 0
reason: Diagnose why Remote Desktop Commander device is offline using existing Fred-Win tunnel without exposing secrets
